set.body: Download and retain the pinned mlx-community/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-8bit snapshot directly on owner's WD My Passport for Mac, including tokenizer/config files. User explicitly requested WD storage. Verify mounted external-volume identity and capacity, preserve existing files, pin upstream commit, independently compare downloaded bytes with published LFS SHA256 / Git blob hashes and file sizes; save external receipt plus small local pointer/provenance. Put download/Xet caches on WD too. No model inference, transcript replacement, private data transfer or deletion in this storage slice.
set.title: [media] Store pinned Qwen3-ASR model on WD Passport
